title: nothing merges to main while a batch's CI is running, the owner included
why: Direct ask, Oct 28 13:36 CDT (shiv): a rule that no one, me included, merges to main while a batch's CI runs. Cause in the open: batch 13's lanes (c182 #777, c187 #778) each conflict with batch 12 (#779), and a merge to main under a running batch run moves the base the run is testing.
note: Next cloud lane, claude-settings only. Add a rule to the root CLAUDE.md Git section (an anchored sentence, beside git-integration-branch-merge and git-never-merge-failing-ci): while a batch's integration PR has a CI run in progress, nothing merges to main, by any session or by shiv. Record it as a decision (his ruling, Oct 28 13:36 CDT). Mechanize it: merge.py and the merge guard refuse to merge any PR while another PR's required-check run is in progress against the same base, and say which run and how to wait (the CI-done comment wakes the session). Red first: a fixture with one batch run in progress and a second PR ready; the merge refuses; with the run done it passes. The limit: a click on GitHub's own Merge button cannot be refused by a hook; the guard stops sessions and merge.py, and the rule binds shiv by his own word. Port: yes, the rule is global. Needs no answer. Placed after c190 (triage 12, Oct 28): it governs every batch. Lane session started Oct 28 (Opus, session_013NEJL3obk8uGUg5NhVk5vC).
